lib/output/look: `studio look` renders frames through a render session and reads the project's timeline as a render loads it.
lib/output/remote-render: `studio render --remote` encodes the pieces a remote container drew under the mix mastered here, writing their snapshot, and the container renders its pieces and stills through a render session.
lib/output/review: A review artifact names the render snapshot it was made from, review lays reply slices into a cut by the render models' splice check and lists the videos render-cuts finds in out/, and review's still sheet reads the stills a render produced.
lib/output/sound-check: `studio mix` loads video.tsx in Node through the render's tsx hooks.
lib/picture/reel: recap.test loads the reel's studio code in Node through the render's tsx hooks.
